name: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited
summary: Tasty Bite Eatables Limited manufactures and sells prepared foods in India and internationally. The company offers ready-to-eat entrées, organic rice and whole grains, simmer sauces, frozen formed foods, and gourmet sauces, protein bowls, base gravies and sauces, and fillings, as well as frozen snacks, such as burgers, patties, and starters. It sells its products under the Tasty Bite brand name. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Pune, India. Tasty Bite Eatables Limited is a subsidiary of Preferred Brands Foods (India) Private Limited.
